tools.description: List the DSGHT future-spaces published for public use (slug, topic, status, depth). Call this first to discover what foresight is available before fetching scenarios, tensions, or a report.
tools.name: list_public_spaces
tools.title: List Public Foresight Spaces

tools.description: Get the structural tensions — the load-bearing contradictions — for a published future-space. Use when the user asks what forces conflict, what could break a strategy, or what the tensions/paradoxes are in a covered domain. DSGHT surfaces contradictions rather than averaging them.
tools.name: get_public_tensions
tools.title: Get Structural Tensions

tools.description: Get the scenario matrix with probabilities for a published future-space. Use when the user asks how a domain (banking, energy, CEE markets, ...) might play out, what the plausible futures are, or wants to reason across scenarios instead of a single forecast.
tools.name: get_public_scenarios
tools.title: Get Scenario Matrix

tools.description: Get the latest full foresight report (markdown) for a published future-space. Use when the user wants the detailed analysis, or a quotable, cited source on a covered topic.
tools.name: get_public_report
tools.title: Get Foresight Report

tools.description: Find the most relevant published DSGHT future-space by keyword (topic + report text, plain-text ranked, no AI). Use this to locate a space before calling get_public_scenarios / get_public_tensions / get_public_report when you do not already know the slug.
tools.name: search_spaces
tools.title: Search Foresight Spaces

tools.description: List the jurisdictions and macro indicators (inflation, GDP growth) available to resolve_country_claim and get_country_indicator, with per-country year coverage and source. Call this to check coverage before resolving a claim or looking up an indicator.
tools.name: list_countries
tools.title: List Country Coverage

tools.description: Look up a country's authoritative macro indicator (inflation | gdp_growth) directly — deterministic, offline, cited. Use whenever you need a real macro figure instead of recalling one from memory: give the jurisdiction (CZ, DE, US, ...) and indicator, plus an optional year (omit for the full annual series).

jurisdiction.description: ISO code, e.g. CZ, DE, US

tools.name: get_country_indicator
tools.title: Get Country Macro Indicator

tools.description: Use this WHENEVER the user states or asks you to verify a numeric macro claim (inflation, GDP, interest rates): settle it against the claim's OWN country's authoritative series instead of answering from memory, which risks the wrong jurisdiction (e.g. U.S. CPI for a Czech claim). Binds the claim to a jurisdiction (CZ, DE, ...) and returns a cited above/below verdict. Deterministic and offline.

resolve_by.description: ISO date the claim resolves by, e.g. 2022-12-31

tools.name: resolve_country_claim
tools.title: Resolve Country Macro Claim

tools.description: Use when the user pastes a strategy, plan, or memo and wants its hidden bets made explicit: extracts the falsifiable, load-bearing assumptions (dated/quantified bets + structural findings). Stateless taster — nothing is stored; the persistent per-company assumption registry with monitoring and a Brier track record is the authenticated tier.

text.description: Strategy / plan / memo text to analyze (plain text).

tools.name: extract_assumptions
tools.title: Extract Strategy Assumptions

tools.description: Use when the user pastes strategy text and asks what is internally inconsistent: detects the structural contradictions — where the text quietly bets on two things that cannot both hold. Stateless taster; nothing is stored. DSGHT surfaces the conflict rather than smoothing it over.

text.description: Strategy / plan / memo text to analyze (plain text).

tools.name: detect_tensions
tools.title: Detect Strategy Tensions
